description: Everyone this user has already contacted, from the same record every Fundz outreach tool reads: emails logged from chat, emails sent from the Fundz app, and Fundz-run campaigns on the account. Per person: the company, last subject and date, number of touches, which lane it went out on, whether they replied or booked, and when the next follow-up is due. The result opens with the total per lane. The list shows at most 100 people, personal sends first, so to check ONE company always pass company (name, domain, id or slug): that answer is complete. Use it for "who have I not heard back from", to check a mailbox for replies from exactly these people, or before writing to a company. Costs one call from the daily API quota.

awaiting_reply.description: true to list only people who have not replied or booked

company.description: Limit to one company (id, slug, domain or name). Complete for that company.

days.description: How far back to look (default 30, max 180)

lane.description: Only one lane: chat (logged from an assistant), fundz_app (sent in the Fundz app) or campaign (Fundz-run campaigns)

name: get_outreach_history
title: Get outreach history
